text.en: Clients consistently praise head trainer Ty and the coaching team for their patience, warmth, and in-depth understanding of canine behavior. Dog owners appreciate how trainers coach both the pets and handlers, teaching manageable exercises that make everyday routines easier to navigate.

Pet parents report major improvements in leash pulling, reactivity, barking, and separation anxiety after private lessons and board-and-train programs. Several clients mention that dogs transformed from overwhelming walking companions into calm, well-mannered pets during outings.

title.en: Regular progress updates and clear guidance

text.en: Reviewers appreciate the thorough daily updates, video check-ins, and photos provided throughout board-and-train stays. Clients note that instructors explain behavioral concepts clearly, reply swiftly to questions, and provide actionable homework between training sessions.

q.en: Do trainers send daily updates during board and train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients consistently mention receiving daily photos, video clips, and progress summaries while their dogs board with the trainers.

q.en: Can the trainers help with leash reactivity and pulling?

a.en: Reviewers highlight significant progress with leash pulling, defensive barking, and reactivity after completing training sessions.

q.en: Are owners coached on how to maintain training at home?

a.en: Yes, trainers provide clear exercises and hands-on guidance to ensure owners feel confident reinforcing habits at home.
